calculation.expression: -((rolling_sum_10(lagged_asset_returns) - rolling_sum_10(lagged_cross_sectional_mean_return)) / rolling_std_40(lagged_asset_returns)) conditioned on lagged negative-return breadth > 55% and lagged VIX 5d change above its lagged 70th percentile over 120 sessions; cross-sectional demean
calculation.description: During broad weakness and rising volatility, rank assets that underperformed their common cross-asset movement over the prior 10 sessions, risk-scaled by 40-session volatility, for reversal over a 10-session horizon. All market inputs are lagged to the prior completed session. Inactive dates receive zero before cross-sectional demeaning.

validation.regime_notes: Strong H10 result in 269 valid cross-sectional dates, but activation is selective (290 of 4330 dates). Chronological daily-third H1 IC was 0.05666, 0.00978, and unavailable in the final partial segment because the stress gate had no late observations; interpret uncertainty conservatively. H20 IC decayed to 0.02262 and failed ICIR.
